description: This file contains API client classes and functions for fetching content from Agility CMS, including methods for retrieving posts, page paths, and page properties, with dynamic module loading and content normalization.

classes.name: APIClient
classes.description: A class for interacting with Agility CMS content, including fetching posts and post details.

methods.name: getClient
methods.description: Returns the appropriate API client based on preview mode.

methods.name: getAgilityPaths
methods.description: Fetches all non-folder paths from the sitemap for static generation.

methods.name: getAgilityPageProps
methods.description: Fetches page data and modules for a given route, resolving modules and additional data.
